  enum Signal
    Ready
    Value(Int)
    Named <ctor>
      code: Int
      label: String = <expr>
  fun returned(): Signal
    =
      Var Ready
  fun pass(value: Signal): Signal
    =
      Var value
  fun score(value: Signal): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Ready
          IntLiteral 0
        arm Value(number)
          Var number
        arm Named(code, _)
          Var code
